digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: Ubuntu Verified jobs occupy 30+ runner-minutes per run while macOS remains the critical path; repeated YAML parsing in bridge-cadence test and redundant subprocess invocations in Pandoc corpus suite are proven non-essential contributors

Redundant work can be eliminated without reducing coverage: schedule YAML hoisting, existential short-circuit assertions, static golden fixtures paired with bounded live Pandoc contracts, and AST provenance indexing all have OSS consensus

Job-level always() predicates prevent GitHub cancellation of superseded Verify runs, causing 25+ minute admission delays for replacement patchsets; cancellation-aware predicates preserve full fallback without obsolete-run work

Post-remediation runs show end-to-end wall times of 21–26 minutes within the 20–30 minute target and no individual pytest phase exceeding 30 seconds, confirming distributed throughput rather than a single long pole

Moving full real-Pandoc corpus replay to scheduled External Integration workflow while retaining small representative live contracts and all 884 product conversions in Verified preserves the boundary oracle without ADR 0095 supersession
